pages.text: Autumn wind swept across the field. Dad made one kite each for Dodo and Mumu.
"I want my kite high in the sky!" Mumu hugged it.
Dodo waved her kite. "The faster you run, the higher it flies. Like a race! I know!"
Holding the string, she raced through the field.
The kite dragged along the ground, then caught on the willow trunk.
"My kite must have wanted a longer walk." Dodo pulled it free.
Mumu turned toward the wind. It pushed against his face.
He gently let out the string. The kite rode the wind and floated up.
It fluttered high in the sky. "It's up! It's up!"
Dodo stood beside Mumu and gently let out her string too. "My kite always takes a walk first!" Two kites fluttered side by side in the sky.
